Method of Attack: Malicious emails distributing a malware downloader (FRIENDSPEAK) that downloads MIXLABEL malware
MIXLABEL configured to contact a command and control domain impersonating Microsoft Store
Use of malicious HTML attachments with iframe or embed tags loading content from compromised websites
Malicious Excel spreadsheets with macros delivering FRIENDSPEAK
Use of geofencing techniques and CAPTCHA challenges to deliver malware
Deployment of Clop ransomware after initial compromise
Data theft and extortion by threatening to release or sell stolen data
Impacted Systems: Organizations in defense, energy, finance, healthcare/pharmaceutical, legal, telecommunications, technology, transportation sectors
Victims primarily in North America and Europe
Machines with keyboard layouts used outside CIS countries
Attack Vector: Malicious email campaigns with HTML attachments
Phishing emails with lures such as remittance documents, invoices, confidential company information
Indicators of Compromise: Command and control domain impersonating Microsoft Store (us-microsoft-store[.[com)
Malicious HTML attachments with iframe/embed tags
Drop in activity during Russian New Year and Orthodox Christmas holidays
